sources.quote: 入出力 コントローラ端子 ×２ メモリーカード差込口 ×２ （ＵＳＢ）端子 ×２ Ｓ４００（ｉ.ＬＩＮＫ）端子 ×１ (新規) エクスパンション ベイ（拡張ベイ） ×１ ＡＶマルチアウト（ＡＶマルチ出力）端子 ×１ デジタルアウト（オプティカル）（光デジタル出力）端子×１
新型「プレイステーション ２」『ＳＣＰＨ－３００００』

notes: Sony's 2001-04-09 Japanese release (PDF; pypdf cannot decode its 90msp-RKSJ-H font, text extracted with macOS PDFKit). Axes labelled (Ｗ/Ｈ/Ｄ): width 301, height 78, depth 182; 2.2 kg recorded as 2200 g.

ports = the release's 入出力 row, complete. The expansion bay (エクスパンション ベイ（拡張ベイ）) is filed as expansion; S400 i.LINK has no §3 kind and is not filed. The controller connector is Sony's own (Sony names it 'Controller port' / コントローラ端子 and no standard); it is filed as controller_proprietary. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. Sony's input/output row does not list the AC inlet, so ports has no power_in item; that absence is Sony's table, not a statement that the console has no inlet. features.power_inlet stays null.
media: the release does not say how discs load; media stays uncovered. Wikidata has no model-level item for SCPH-30000; external_ids left null.
